s_structure.definition: s = (v_u^126/v_u^10)/(v_d^126/v_d^10), v_u^126 = d_u alpha + e_u beta, v_d^126 = d_d conj(beta) + e_d conj(alpha)
s_structure.lemma: For a G3221 composition (d_u = d_d, e_u = e_d) s - 1 = -e (|alpha|^2 - |beta|^2)/(alpha (d conj(beta) + e conj(alpha))): s = 1 iff e = 0 (no conjugate mixing) or tan beta = 1.  The so(4) commutant on the real (2,2) is R, so every G3221-invariant real quadratic form on m copies is A (x) I_4, its eigenvectors are a (x) v with v a real (2,2) vector, and ||P_+ v|| = ||P_- v|| (P_- = conj(P_+)): one tuning of a G3221-invariant mass form gives tan beta = 1 for the 10 and |v_u^126| = |v_d^126|, hence s = 1 and CKM = 1 (G8 v2 lemma_s1_g3221)

verdict: EXACT: every vacuum in the degree-2-SOS-certified witness family (the committed witness, the r_S family and the O36 lambda_H member, certified by g3_sm_pati_salam_higgs_quartic_member_v20) is flavour-dead: M_e = phase x M_d^T and CKM = 1 (tan beta = 1) at the level of the light (dimension-4) Yukawa matrices.  The Weyl element g_de (pi-rotation in the (3,5) plane, lift Gamma_3 Gamma_5) fixes every charged-sector vev bilinear and maps d[+--] to e[+++]; sigma_std couples only nu^c nu^c; so spec(M_d) = spec(M_e) for any 16/16bar content (L1).  g_cust (the (7,9) plane) gives spec(M_u) = spec(M_d) exactly and CKM = 1 at the dimension-4 level at tan beta = 1 (L2); with 16bar content the charged current of full mass eigenstates is (phases)(1 - K), K = U_d^dag P_{16bar SU(2)_L-singlet} U_d = O(v^2/M_V^2) (dimension-6 non-unitarity; exactly 0 without 16bar states).  This holds for any H-linear portal (L1 is portal-robust; every doublet-coupled portal (O15, O28, O38, O45_B02) makes q0 a saddle, O45_B01 has no doublet coupling (flavour-inert), and any portal != 0 is outside the SOS27 certificate), for vectorlike 16s on contract scalars and P/Q/R promotion (the contract's 74 couplings have no X-neutral 16bar.16 pair), and for a 120_H added as SOS squares with a GUT-scale (15,2,2)_120 (M15 ~ M_GUT): the d/e split then enters only through a (15,2,2)_120 admixture of O((v_R/M15)^2) = O(r0^2) (X-parity bounds the PS-breaking H/T entries at O(r0^2): Sigma number even through degree 11, the first odd-Sigma monomial at degree 12); a tuned-light (15,2,2)_120, which SOS squares allow, gives O(1) splitting (research selection120 C4_tuned_15) and is excluded only numerically (no perturbative two-loop root, research).  The 126bar's (15,2,2) (not the 120's) has m^2 = p^2/2 + O(r0^2) across the family.  Off q0 every H-linear portal's down-type 126bar source needs a (15,1,1) or (15,1,3) Phi vev, i.e. it leaves the certified orientation.  RESEARCH_RECORD (not re-derived): the 45 scalar portal, vectorlike matter with a reoriented 210 and the off-witness ERT channel also split d from e, but all sit off the certified orientation; a second 126bar is Landau-excluded at BM-DA1 (8.1e17 GeV, two loops).  G8 is not closed, the contract and the G3-G5 certificates are not falsified, and no gate status changes.

weyl_lemmas.lemma_L1: For any content of 16/16bar Weyl fermions coupled only to the witness vevs (singlets S, Phi17 and bare masses, p, H in span(e6..e9), sigma_std): the charged blocks (Q = -1/3, -1) see no sigma_std (it couples only neutral states), every other vev bilinear is exactly S_de-invariant, and S_de maps the colour-(+--) Q = -1/3 sector onto the Q = -1 sector in both chiralities; so M_e = S_de^T M_d S_de up to unit phases and spec(M_d) = spec(M_e), light and heavy, colour by colour (the charged-sector vevs are SO(6)-invariant)
weyl_lemmas.lemma_L2: At tan beta = 1 (a real neutral doublet, reduced to e8 by the (8,9) torus element): S_cust fixes the bilinears of the singlets, p and e8 exactly, sigma_std stays in the neutral sector, and S_cust maps every up-quark sector onto the down-quark sector of the same colour and acts on every SU(2)_L doublet state as the W_L partner map: spec(M_u) = spec(M_d) exactly and U_u = S U_d, so CKM = 1 exactly at the level of the light (dimension-4) Yukawa matrices (and for purely chiral 16 content); with 16bar content the W_L current does not act on the 16bar SU(2)_L-singlet components, so the charged-current matrix of full mass eigenstates is (phases)(1 - K), K = U_d^dag P_{16bar SU(2)_L-singlet} U_d = O(v^2/M_V^2) (dimension-6 non-unitarity; exactly 0 without 16bar states)

xparity_120.consequence: At the witness the only PS-breaking vev is Sigma = r0 sigma_std; p, S and Phi17 are PS singlets.  Every X-neutral H/T bilinear operator through total degree 11 carries an even Sigma number, and its p-only (PS-invariant) part has zero (1,2,2) <-> (15,2,2) matrix elements, so every PS-breaking H/T bilinear entry is O(r0^2) (two Sigma insertions).  The 120 has no SM-Cartan-neutral vector, so every T-linear term vanishes at q0 (checked explicitly for six covariants) and 120 squares that vanish at q0 keep q0 an exact SOS minimum (research construction sos120 E3).  Z17 = X mod 17 for every field, so Z17 removes nothing further
